content:
Hippocrates Wellness Hosts Health & Happiness Open House Event @ 4 PM on April 30th, 2019

WEST PALM BEACH, Florida, April 17, 2019 – Hippocrates Wellness will be hosting its monthly Health & Happiness open house event on its main campus at Wigmore Hall in West Palm Beach, Florida on Tuesday, April 30th @ 4 PM. This event is part of the Institute’s monthly lecture series, which showcases its Life Transformation Program. This 3-week wellness program is the core curriculum that has enriched the lives of tens of thousands of individuals since 1987. The open house highlights a tour of the 60-acre campus, an educational seminar, including the option to partake in our organic, raw vegan, nutrient-dense foods.

Program Specialists will be showcasing the Hippocrates programs during the event.

To register online for this event, visit: www.hippocratesinst.org/events.

For more information about Hippocrates Wellness, visit: https://hippocratesinst.org/ or call directly at (561) 471-8876. Hippocrates Wellness is located in West Palm Beach, Florida.
